title: Story premise EDU031: The Closed-Notebook Bridge
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (learning/study). Hook: Can you rebuild it after the page disappears? Takeaway/theme: A retrieval attempt can reveal gaps that looking at the answer hides.
description: A learner wants to know whether a diagram is understood, but recognizes every label only while the page is open. Rebuilding it from blank blocks reveals gaps that can be checked against the source.
